# Scandinavian Theme

[GitHub Download Link](https://github.com/EvobyteDigitalBiology/st-styled/blob/main/src/st_yled/themes/scandinavian/config.toml)

![Scandinavian Theme Preview Placeholder](https://evo-byte.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/scandinavian.png)

Scandinavian offers a minimal and calm visual system with balanced spacing and subtle contrast.

## Highlights

- Clean, modern surfaces with restrained color usage
- Excellent for productivity and knowledge apps
- Balanced light and dark variants
